description: The check of elision-only does not run for the verdict unique. On A, text → A [T] is the one derivation. Written back, A T would parse through both alternatives, and the check would fail. But the verdict is unique, so the text parses (engine §6, §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text A [T] | A z
%rule z T
